title: Stein's unbiased risk estimate and Hyv\"arinen's score matching
abstract: arXiv:2502.20123v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Given a collection of observed signals corrupted with Gaussian noise, how can we learn to optimally denoise them? This fundamental problem arises in both empirical Bayes and generative modeling. In empirical Bayes, the predominant approach is via nonparametric maximum likelihood estimation (NPMLE), while in generative modeling, score matching (SM) methods have proven very successful. In our setting, Hyv\"arinen's implicit SM is equivalent to another classical idea from statistics---Stein's Unbiased Risk Estimate (SURE). Revisiting SURE minimization, we establish, for the first time, that SURE achieves nearly parametric rates of convergence of the regret in the classical empirical Bayes setting with homoscedastic noise. We also prove that SURE-training can achieve fast rates of convergence to the oracle denoiser in a commonly studied misspecified model. translated_title: 斯坦无偏风险估计与Hyvärinen分数匹配
translated_abstract: 给定一组被高斯噪声污染的观测信号，我们如何学习以最优方式对它们进行去噪？这一基本问题同时出现在经验贝叶斯和生成式建模中。在经验贝叶斯中，主流方法是非参数极大似然估计（NPMLE），而在生成式建模中，分数匹配（SM）方法已被证明非常成功。在我们的设定中，Hyvärinen的隐式分数匹配等价于统计学中另一个经典思想——斯坦无偏风险估计（SURE）。通过重新审视SURE最小化，我们首次证明了在具有同方差噪声的经典经验贝叶斯设定中，SURE能够达到接近参数速率的遗憾收敛速度。我们还证明了SURE训练在一个常被研究的误设模型中能够以快速收敛速度逼近oracle去噪器。我们展示了如何在涉及异方差噪声的设定中实际实现我们的方法……
tldr: 该论文首次证明了SURE最小化与Hyvärinen隐式分数匹配的等价性，并从理论上证明SURE在经验贝叶斯去噪中可实现接近参数速率的遗憾收敛，以及在误设模型下向oracle去噪器的快速收敛。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes for the first time the equivalence between SURE minimization and Hyvärinen's implicit score matching, and proves that SURE achieves nearly parametric regret convergence rates in empirical Bayes denoising as well as fast convergence to the oracle denoiser under misspecification.
